mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated central bank tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points and decline in housing starts by more than 5% over the past month signals an economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 0.2pp increase in 1 month AND HOUST > 5% decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.2pp and HOUST decreases by >5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in industrial production by more than 1% over the past month signals a deepening recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% and INDPRO declines by >1% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past month signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines by >5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A quarter-over-quarter decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines by >0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% and rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% year-over-year over the past month signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 1% decline in 1 month AND CPIAUCSL YoY change > 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by >1% and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 0.5%.
